title: Email forwarding
description: Send new bank notices to a private address and review them before creating transactions.
loadError: We couldn't load your address. Try again.
setupUnavailable: Email forwarding will be available after inbound delivery is configured. You can still review and upload captures in Documents.
intro: Create an address just for bank notices. Then set up a Gmail filter to forward only the messages you choose.
createError: We couldn't create the address. Try again.
addAddressBody: On a computer, open Gmail → Settings → See all settings → Forwarding and POP/IMAP → Add a forwarding address. Paste the address above.
waitingForVerification: Gmail will send a verification message to this address. It will appear here when received. This can take a few minutes.
verificationReceivedBody: Gmail's message arrived. Open the link and verify the address there. When Gmail says it is done, return here and mark this step as verified.
verifiedBody: You marked the address as verified in Gmail. Anotto cannot inspect that setting; create a filter and test with a new notice.
markVerifiedError: We couldn't save your confirmation. Try again.
createFilterTitle: Forward only the notices you choose
filterLocked: Verify the address in Gmail and mark the previous step as complete before setting up a filter.
filterCreatedInGmail: Create the filter in Gmail, not on this screen.
filterStepFindSender: Enter Bancolombia and distinctive names for your other banks below. Gmail can search for those words in the sender, subject, or content, even when a new address appears.
filterStepOpenOptions: Copy the search, paste it into Gmail's main search box, and review the results. If a notice is missing, add its exact sender address in the optional section.
filterStepChooseForwarding: With that search in Gmail, click Show search options and then Create filter. Check that the criteria were retained; select Forward it and choose your private Anotto address.
filterStepFinish: Click Create filter again. Only new matching messages will be forwarded. Check the filter with a new notice.
filteredOnly: Keep forwarding of all incoming mail turned off.
senderGuideTitle: Capture notices even when the sender changes
senderGuideDescription: Search for distinctive bank words anywhere in the email. Add exact addresses for notices that omit those words. Create the filter in Gmail.
senderGuideCatalogTitle: Show clues for finding each bank's mail
senderGuideVerify: These are clues for finding earlier notices. Review which messages each word finds in Gmail before creating the filter.
senderGuideKeywordsHint: Bancolombia is already included. Add lulobank, banco falabella, or another distinctive phrase; avoid generic words such as bank.
senderGuideExactAddressesTitle: Add exact addresses for missing notices
senderGuideAddressesHint: Optional. Copy full addresses for notices that do not match your bank words.
senderGuideInvalidEntries: Correct invalid words or addresses. No partial search will be generated.
senderGuidePasteInSearch: Paste this search into Gmail's main search box and review the results before creating the filter.
senderGuideMixedContent: A broad search can also forward promotions and codes. The app separates non-financial notices and omits detected code content; review Gmail results before enabling the filter.
reviewInboxBody: Possible transactions remain pending for your review. Clearly non-financial emails are separated; no transaction is ever created automatically.
privacyNote: Only new messages matching your filter enter review. Transactions are never created automatically.
removeDescription: This address will stop receiving notices. Also remove the filter and forwarding address in Gmail; this action cannot change your Gmail settings.
removeError: We couldn't remove the address. Try again.
